teaser: The smell of candle wax and old coffee lingers after everyone else has gone. You are a 9, an ISTP, and that lingering is the detail: you stayed to finish clearing, not because anyone asked. The 9 carries an old debt to give something back to the wider human mess; the ISTP wants that debt paid in concrete work, not sentiment. What is particular to this crossing is how quietly the giving gets done — a chair stacked, a fuse fixed, a ride arranged — while the larger compassion stays mostly unspoken, visible only in what gets handled without complaint.
excerpt: A toolkit stays in the trunk of the car, just in case.
